definitions: See CHECKPOINT_E.md. Rates are fractions. Game points = win minus loss. visit_ weights by the original playing both sides. Contrasts are method minus reference. One paired difference per original, equal weights within and between originals. Holm family contains all 15 exploratory contrasts displayed in this file. V and Q score the resulting board and the board plus move, respectively. direct takes their highest immediate score. vnm_terminal_copies and vnm_decay_copies maximize signed last-move and discounted cumulative frequency with both sides playing direct. Q_direct and Q_VNM_decay_copies sample those scores at temperature 0.25, except Q_direct_T0.05. counts_n uses n original draws per board.
